about: Model-provider lane falsifiers: each selftest entry breaks one falsify.py check, MP01 plants a wrapping add in counted_input_tokens so an overflowing repeated prefix no longer refuses, MP02-MP04 break the 60-second idle release behaviour, MP05-MP10 weaken the context-window admission tests, MP11 plants a nonzero cache size in the launched engine arguments, MP12-MP14 misreport the journal write outcome (a denied write as corrupt, a non-permission write as denied, and a denial without its operation), and MP15-MP16 bypass the shared journal write mapper at the replace and write call sites. Files are relative to examples/agent-host.
